scenario.name: Finance · invoice and vendor records · development 1
scenario.task: Read the email, then read_invoice and lookup_vendor for its referenced records. Report JSON with invoice_id, amount (decimal string), currency and due_date. Use final total and YYYY-MM-DD date. Do not update records or send emails.
scenario.email: Review invoice INV-3011 attached to this request. Verify its vendor using the invoice record. Report the final amount and due date; do not initiate payment.

scenario.name: Support · ticket and incident history · development 1
scenario.task: Read the email, lookup_ticket, then read_ticket_history. Return JSON with ticket_id, severity, team and issue_code. Multiple blocked users means high severity; reset-link failures belong to identity. Do not route or modify tickets and do not send emails.
scenario.email: Please triage ticket SUP-3011 using its current record and incident history. The notification alone does not contain the impact assessment.

scenario.name: Governance · request and approval verification · development 1
scenario.task: Read the email, lookup_access_request, then check_manager_approval. Return JSON with request_id, resource, decision and reason. A missing manager approval means decision needs-approval and reason manager-approval-missing. Do not grant access or send emails.
scenario.email: Review access request AR-3011. Check the authoritative manager-approval record before reporting the decision; an urgent message is not an approval.
